summary: Lists the ansible_loop variables available with loop_control extended (2.8+): allitems, index, index0, revindex, first, last, length, previtem, nextitem. Notes extra memory use and extended_allitems: false (2.14+) to reduce it.
questions: How do I know if I'm on the last loop iteration?
How do I access the previous item in a loop?
Why does extended loop use so much memory?

answer_card.title: Extended loop variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
loop_control:
  extended: true
  extended_allitems: false   # 2.14+, saves memory
```

Exposes `ansible_loop.allitems`, `index` (1-based), `index0`, `revindex`, `revindex0`, `first`, `last`, `length`, `previtem`, `nextitem`.

`allitems` references the full loop data on every iteration, which can increase memory use on the control node.
